name: Wizard PhD Set
svgFragment:
<g id="PROP-WIZARD-KIT">

  <circle cx="200" cy="105" r="50" fill="#fef08a" opacity="0.25" />

  <circle cx="200" cy="105" r="20" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6" />

  <!-- Staff Shaft -->
  <path d="M 193 275 L 207 275 L 204 120 L 196 120 Z" fill="#78350f" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <!-- Staff Wood Grain & Highlights -->
  <path d="M 197 270 L 199 125" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <path d="M 203 260 L 201 150" stroke="#451a03" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Staff Topper Mount (Golden Cup) -->

  <!-- Staff Shadow on Shaft -->
  <path d="M 195 126 L 205 126 L 203 140 L 197 140 Z" fill="#000000" opacity="0.2" />

  <!-- Scroll Body Back/Base -->

  <rect x="194" y="91" width="12" height="28" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <path d="M 196 119 L 191 136 L 198 133 L 203 136 L 200 119" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" />

  <circle cx="200" cy="105" r="8" fill="#facc15" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3.5" />

  <path d="M 160 84 C 180 90, 220 90, 240 84 C 220 81, 180 81, 160 84 Z" fill="#000000" opacity="0.15" />

  <!-- Hat Brim -->

  <circle cx="234" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#ca8a04" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Star 3 -->
  <path d="M 200 25 Q 200 28 197 28 Q 200 28 200 31 Q 200 28 203 28 Q 200 28 200 25" fill="#fef08a" />

  <path d="M 170 95 L 230 95 L 230 100 L 170 100 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.4" />

  <path d="M 145 100 Q 145 104 141 104 Q 145 104 145 108 Q 145 104 149 104 Q 145 104 145 100" fill="#ffffff" />
  <path d="M 255 112 Q 255 116 251 116 Q 255 116 255 120 Q 255 116 259 116 Q 255 116 255 112" fill="#ffffff" />

  <circle cx="245" cy="92" r="4" fill="#fde047" />
  <circle cx="238" cy="128" r="2.5" fill="#ffffff" />
